description: Steam game picker (plan.md decisions 2-5, items 1.1-1.7). Optional STEAM_API_KEY; IStoreService/GetAppList (games only, paginated by last_appid) cached in a new steam_apps table with a steam_app_list row recording fetched_at/attempted_at; refreshed on demand when older than a day (background when rows exist, awaited when never fetched), guarded in-process (shared promise) and across processes (claim on attempted_at, which also backs off 10 min after a failure), 15 s timeout per request, a failed refresh keeps the old cache; ranked case-insensitive search. Tournaments store game { appId, name, headerImage } (jsonb, migration 0005_steam_games). Admin General tab: game card with an accessible combobox that also works without JS. Game shown on the tournament header, TournamentList (org page, dashboard). REST: `game` on Tournament/TournamentSummary/TournamentUpdate and GET /api/v1/steam/apps?q=. Independent of FEAT-002..005 but runs first because it owns the migration.

src/lib/tournaments.ts: add `/** A Steam game a tournament is played in, copied from the Steam cache when picked. */ export interface Game { appId: number; name: string; headerImage: string }`.

src/lib/server/db/schema.ts: import `type Game` with StageSettings; add to `tournaments` after themeId: `/** The Steam game it is played in (M8). */ game: jsonb('game').$type<Game>()`. After matchMessages add `steamApps = pgTable('steam_apps', { appId: integer('app_id').primaryKey(), name: text('name').notNull() })` and `steamAppList = pgTable('steam_app_list', { id: text('id').primaryKey(), fetchedAt: timestamp('fetched_at', { withTimezone: true }), attemptedAt: timestamp('attempted_at', { withTimezone: true }), appCount: integer('app_count').notNull().default(0) })` with doc comments (see plan 2); export `type SteamApp`.

Run `corepack pnpm db:generate --name steam_games` (prefix `$env:DATABASE_URL='postgres://root:mysecretpassword@localhost:5432/local';` if needed) and `corepack pnpm db:migrate`; inspect drizzle/0005_steam_games.sql (2 CREATE TABLE + 1 ALTER TABLE ADD COLUMN only).

New src/lib/server/services/steam.ts: constants (API url, LIST_ID 'games', PAGE_SIZE 50_000, MAX_PAGES 20, MAX_AGE 24 h, RETRY_AFTER 10 min, TIMEOUT 15_000, SEARCH_LIMIT 10); `steamHeaderImage(appId)` = `https://shared.akamai.steamstatic.com/store_item_assets/steam/apps/${appId}/header.jpg`; exported `fetchSteamGames(apiKey, fetch, timeout)` (query params key, include_games=true, include_dlc/software/videos/hardware=false, max_results, last_appid; AbortSignal.timeout; Zod page schema; non-OK/invalid -> throw; skip empty names; stop on !have_more_results, MAX_PAGES or a non-advancing last_appid); `createSteamApps({ apiKey, fetch = (input, init) => globalThis.fetch(input, init), now = () => new Date(), timeout = TIMEOUT })` returning `{ enabled, search(query), find(appId), refresh() }` with: an in-process `refreshing` promise; the claim `db.insert(steamAppList).values({ id, attemptedAt: now }).onConflictDoUpdate({ target: steamAppList.id, set: { attemptedAt: now }, setWhere: or(isNull(attemptedAt), lt(attemptedAt, now - RETRY_AFTER)) }).returning()` (no row -> skip); fetch outside the transaction; replace inside one transaction (delete, batches of 5000 with onConflictDoNothing, set fetchedAt/appCount); errors caught and logged with console.error (message only, never the URL); `ensureFresh()` (fresh -> return; stale with fetchedAt -> start refresh without awaiting; never fetched -> await); `search` (disabled or empty query -> []; LIKE on lower(name) with \ % _ escaped; order by exact/prefix/word-start/anywhere case, length(name), name, app_id; limit 10; map to Game with steamHeaderImage); `find(appId)` (disabled -> undefined). Export `type SteamApps = ReturnType<typeof createSteamApps>` and `steamApps = createSteamApps({ apiKey: STEAM_API_KEY })` (import from '$app/env/private').

New src/lib/server/services/steam.db.spec.ts using mockFetch and an injected `now` (see plan item 1.2 for the full case list): pagination + games-only params + key + last_appid on page 2; stored rows/appCount/fetchedAt; fresh cache never fetches; stale cache returns old rows then `await apps.refresh()` shows the new ones; empty cache waits; 500, invalid body and timeout (`timeout: 20`, handler rejecting on request.signal abort) keep rows and fetchedAt; back-off: no second fetch within 10 min, one after now + 11 min; `Promise.all` of two searches and two instances on an empty cache fetch once; ranking order, case-insensitivity, literal %/_, limit 10; disabled instance never fetches; headerImage URL.

Migration drizzle/0005_steam_games.sql (+ meta/0005_snapshot.json, _journal entry idx 5) = 2 CREATE TABLE + 1 ADD COLUMN, applied to local; e2e DB migrates via the webServer, db tests via db-setup. REST: Game component schema; game on Tournament and TournamentSummary (toSummary spreads the row); TournamentUpdate.game { appId } | null; updateTournament endpoint now documents conflicts [409, 422] and mentions game in its description; new tag Games and op searchSteamApps GET /steam/apps?q= (route src/routes/api/v1/steam/apps/+server.ts); openapi.db.spec.ts expects 30. Admin JSON endpoint: src/routes/t/[org]/[tournament]/admin/games/+server.ts (requireTournamentAdmin). Admin General tab: load returns game and steam (null without a key); actions setGame / clearGame (both answer { gameSaved: true }, errors { gameError }). Deviations from the FEAT text (all small, no behaviour the user would object to): (1) SteamGame has an extra prop named = true; TournamentList passes named={false} because the game name is joined into the detail line. (2) On an image error SteamGame keeps the and swaps src to an inline 1x1 transparent GIF (data: URI) instead of removing it: Svelte replays pre-hydration error events, so removing it would also drop the alt text (and the e2e alt checks with the CDN aborted); the --surface-2 box keeps the layout. (3) GamePicker sets enhanced in onMount, not $effect (eslint svelte/prefer-writable-derived rejects $state+$effect; PanZoom already uses onMount). Options carry aria-label={game.name} (so the option name isn't 'Artwork of X X'), onmousedown preventDefault (focus stays in the input) and an Enter onkeydown (avoids a11y_click_events_have_key_events without svelte-ignore); blur closes the list (covers Tab). The role=status paragraph is .visually-hidden while options show and visible when nothing was found. (4) steamApps.find returns undefined for ids outside 1..2^31-1 (int column), so huge ids answer 422, not 500. (5) The GetAppList page schema requires response.apps, so an empty or garbled answer throws and keeps the cache. (6) e2e no-JS test fills the Address fields itself: the createOrganization/createTournament helpers rely on JS to suggest the slug. For PLAN.md M8 notes (FEAT-005): Steam cache = steam_apps + steam_app_list ('games' row: fetched_at, attempted_at, app_count); refreshed on search/find when older than 24 h (background when a list exists, awaited when never fetched); in-process shared promise + cross-process claim on attempted_at (INSERT ... ON CONFLICT DO UPDATE ... WHERE attempted_at IS NULL OR < now - 10 min RETURNING), which is also the 10 min back-off after a failure; 15 s per request; replace in one transaction; errors logged with the message only (the URL holds the key). Search: lower(name) LIKE with \ % _ escaped, ranked exact/prefix/word start/anywhere, then length, name, app id, limit 10. Header image URL https://shared.akamai.steamstatic.com/store_item_assets/steam/apps//header.jpg, copied into tournaments.game when picked. e2e: e2e/db.ts (E2E_DATABASE_URL moved there from playwright.config.ts, seedSteamApps with the postgres client), webServer STEAM_API_KEY 'e2e-dummy-key', CDN aborted with context.route. M9 CSP: img-src needs https://shared.akamai.steamstatic.com and data: (the blank fallback), besides the existing avatar hosts. CSRF setup untouched. The formatDate timeStyle crash in the tournament layout (item 4.3) is still there for FEAT-004. `corepack pnpm format` also rewrote .agents/tasks/orchestrator-progress.md (prettier).
